title: person_state report v1
description: The `person_state` block a world carries after POST /world/person-state: the report for the call just made, not accumulated state. It is overwritten by the next such call; history.operations is where the sequence is recorded. A change asking for the state a record already reads as is reported with `changed: false`, writes nothing, and records no operation -- an absent status reads as present, so stamping one in would move the bytes of a document whose reproducibility is a contract.

notes.description: What this call deliberately did not do, stated at the call that caused it rather than left for a consumer to discover from behaviour.

block.description: Which person list the uid resolved to. `dreads` is the antagonist cast inside the heroes block; it is a different list, not a different vocabulary.

token.description: The block's own word for `to_status`, which is what was written into the record. Every value here is one a block already used; this route publishes no new word.
